name: Sally
message: 「Heeere goes, splash♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyooeeeh, c-coooold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」
Sally is at Tsukinoo Park. That in itself isn't unusual.
Sally has completely become a part of Ryuusei Town, popping up all over the place.
It's just......

name: Sally
message: 「Brrrrr, chatter-chatter-chatter」
Sally is half-crouching at the edge of the pier with her butt facing the ocean, not moving a muscle.
For some reason she's freezing cold, the sound of her chattering teeth echoing out.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well look at flat-chest over there, doing some real old-school fishing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Fishing? How is she supposed to fish in a pose like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look closer, the tip of her tail is dipped in the sea, ain't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, you're right」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm, hmm? P-P-P-Prez, h-h-h-hey thereee」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally, you're going to get frostbite doing that, you know? Come on」
I grab Sally's tail and pull it out of the seawater. There isn't any bait attached to it.

name: Sally
message: 「Fwaaah~, Prez's hand is so toasty warm~」

name: Sally
message: 「Wait, don't get in my way! I'm gonna bring a fish to Lolochi!」

name: Synn
message: 「To Lolotte?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, Lolochi seemed kinda down. I bet she's hungry.」

name: Sally
message: 「I was gonna give her a beef bowl, but I accidentally ate it myself......」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofuu, if I catch a fish instead, it won't cost any money! I'm such a genius!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uhh, even so, that method is pushing it」

name: Sally
message: 「Bleh! Lolochi said you can catch big ones right here!」

name: Synn
message: 「Back during the social gathering......」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeere goes, one more splash♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeek, it's fweezing cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy, can't you use your powers or something to let Sally-chan catch a tuna?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I ain't got any mystical power like that, pal.」

name: Sally
message: 「Brrr-brrr-brrr, cold, cold, cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Say, Sally-chan, what kind of fish dishes do you like?」

name: Sally
message: 「T-T-T-Takoyaki♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. If it's takoyagi, we can make it with the ingredients I have at home. I've got a grill pan too. Let's make some together and bring it to Lolotte.」
I pull Sally-chan's tail out of the seawater once again.

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa. Does Lolo-chi like takoyaki too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody hates takoyagi.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama, just to be sure, you're sayin' that on purpose, right? That tako-ya-'gi' thing.」

name: Sally
message: 「Tako... yagi?」

name: Synn
message: 「A hidden local specialty that was super popular with the kids in Ryuusei Town!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's closed down now, but there used to be a takoyaki shop run by an old man.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, everyone in my class, and I used to pool our allowance money and buy from there all the time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thing is, the old man was a total cheapskate, so instead of octopus, he used chikuwa, konjac, and pickled plums.」

name: Synn
message: 「When us kids complained and made a huge fuss about it, the old man got mad...」

name: Synn
message: 「He added two little marks to the sign, turning it into a 'takoyagi' shop.」

name: Synn
message: 「And thus was born takoyaki filled with 'takoyagi' goat meat that tasted just like chikuwa, konjac, and pickled plums.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, was it yummy?」

name: Synn
message: 「It was super delicious. Cheap, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If Synn-sama says it was cheap, it must've been practically free. I feel for the poor old geezer havin' to deal with a bunch of brats.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna cook takoyagi and bring it to Lolo-chi!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's head off to my place」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir」
Taking Sally-chan with me, I head toward Grand Palace Sakura.

name: Paqy
message: 「How 'bout that, Lord Synn? Even Demons don't just live for their own greed, ya know? We ain't half bad, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never thought you were, not even once」
With Sally―chan helping me out, I recreated Ryuusei Town's―kids―only―hidden specialty, takoyagi, for the first time in years.
Just as they finished baking, having caught wind of it from somewhere, Riesling-san came by to claim half of them.
Sally-chan and I polished off the remaining half.
